chapter.verse: Tua hi a, ka ki-ip zawh nawnlo uh ciangin Athens khua ah ko teng kia ka taamsuak nuam uh hi.
Na upna uh tawh kisai-in note hong kipsak ding leh hong thapia dingin i sanggampa leh Khris' Lungdamna Thu tangkokhiatna ah Pasian' sunga naseppih Timothy kong sawl uh hi.
Tua pen hih gimnate hangin kuamah a linglawn loh nading ahi hi. A hang pen hih' adingin ko hong kisehkhol ahihlam nomaumah in na thei uh hi.
A hang pen gimna a thuak ding ka hi uh ci-in note' kiangah kong om lai-un kong genkhol uh a, na theih mah bangun tua bang lianin a piang hita hi.
Hih thu hangin siatzolpa in note hong siatzol khin ahihkhak ding leh ka nasep uh a mawkna a suahkhak ding launa tawh ka ki-ip zawh nawnloh ciangin na upna uh ka theih nadingin hong sawl ka hi hi.

Ahi zongin tu-in ahihleh note' kiangpan Timothy hong tung khin a, note' upna leh itna thu ahi zongin, ngaihna tawh hong phawk den na hihna uh leh note tawh kimuh ding ka lunggulh mah bangun note zong ko tawh kimuh ding lunggulh na hihna uh ahi zongin, lungdamhuai thu hong puak khin hi.
Hih thu hangin, sanggamte aw, lungkhamna leh gimna namkim ka thuak kawmkal mahun na upna uh tungtawnin note' vai ah noptuamna ka ngah uh hi.
A hang pen Topa' sungah na dinkip uhleh tu-in kote a nungta ka hi uh hi.
Note' hangin i Pasian' mai-ah lungdamna a dimtak tawh nuamsa ka hih manun note tawh kisai-in Pasian' kiangah bangci lungdam kohna nam puakkik thei ding ka hi uh hiam?
Tua hi a, note tawh maitang kimu-in upna thu ah na kisap teng uh kong cinsak theih nadingun a sun a zan ci lo-in hihtheihtawp thu ka ngen uh hi.
Tu-in i Pa ahi Pasian mahmah in ahi zongin, i Topa Jesu in ahi zongin ka lampi uh note' kiangah tangtak hong tungsak henla
note kong itdan uh tawh kibangin Topa in note' itna zong khatlekhat' tungah ahi zongin, vekpi' tungah ahi zongin a khang, a dimlet hong hisak ta hen.
